name: AirPods
author: Augusto Soto
description: Battery, noise control and ear detection for AirPods, driven through the airpods-tui daemon

barWidget.description: Battery and noise control for connected AirPods

schema.label: List global shortcuts
schema.description: Include the Hyprland bindings (Super+Alt+A, Super+Alt+N) in the shortcut list. Turn this off if you rebind or remove them, so the list does not advertise keys that no longer work.

schema.label: Force AAC on connect
schema.description: AirPods only support SBC and AAC, and the negotiated codec is not stable across reconnects — it has been observed dropping to SBC-XQ on its own. This re-selects the AAC card profile a few seconds after each connect.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: What sits next to the glyph. The glyph itself always shows the active noise mode, so it needs no label of its own. Changeable from the panel's settings section.

schema.label: Hide when disconnected
schema.description: Take the widget out of the bar entirely while no AirPods are connected, rather than showing a dimmed glyph.

schema.label: Low battery warning (%)
schema.description: Below this the bar label is tinted. 0 disables the warning.
